```{=html}
<div class="nr-widget" id="nr-prompts">
  <div class="nr-controls">
    <label>Prompt format
      <select id="nr-prompt-format"><option value="new">New: SEP / EOO / QUERY / EOS</option><option value="legacy">Legacy: X / Y</option></select>
    </label>
  </div>
  <p id="nr-prompt-summary" class="nr-readout" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <details>
    <summary>Inspect all 64 observations and the query</summary>
    <p class="nr-small">The first block is the prompt. The second block is the supervised continuation.</p>
    <pre class="nr-token-block" id="nr-prompt-text" tabindex="0" aria-label="Complete 64-observation prompt"></pre>
    <p><strong>Supervised continuation</strong></p>
    <pre class="nr-token-block" id="nr-answer-text"></pre>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Inspect the underlying continuous values</summary>
    <p class="nr-small" id="nr-latent-description"></p>
    <div class="nr-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Continuous values for the complete example">
      <table class="nr-data-table"><thead><tr><th>Row</th><th>x₁</th><th>x₂</th><th>Clean s</th><th>Noise ε</th><th>Observed y</th></tr></thead><tbody id="nr-example-rows"></tbody></table>
    </div>
  </details>
  <noscript>Enable JavaScript to inspect the complete example. The static three-observation example above shows both formats without JavaScript.</noscript>
</div>
```
